script = '''
import fitz
import subprocess
import os

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)

print("=" * 60)
print(f"PDF: {pdf_path}")
print(f"Total pages: {len(doc)}")
print("=" * 60)

# --- Extract text from all pages ---
print("\\n>>> EXTRACTED TEXT (all pages) <<<\\n")
all_text = []
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    all_text.append(text)
    print(f"--- Page {i+1} ---")
    print(text if text.strip() else "(no extractable text)")
    print()

# --- OCR on the first page image ---
print("=" * 60)
print(">>> OCR ON FIRST PAGE IMAGE <<<")
print("=" * 60)

page = doc[0]
zoom = 2  # higher resolution for better OCR
mat = fitz.Matrix(zoom, zoom)
pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
img_path = "first_page.png"
pix.save(img_path)
print(f"First page rendered to {img_path} ({pix.width}x{pix.height})")

# Run tesseract OCR
try:
    ocr_result = subprocess.run(
        ["tesseract", img_path, "stdout"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60
    )
    ocr_text = ocr_result.stdout.strip()
    if ocr_result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"Tesseract stderr: {ocr_result.stderr}")
    print("\\n--- OCR Result (First Page) ---")
    print(ocr_text if ocr_text else "(no text detected by OCR)")
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Tesseract not found, installing...")
    os.system("apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq tesseract-ocr > /dev/null 2>&1")
    ocr_result = subprocess.run(
        ["tesseract", img_path, "stdout"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60
    )
    ocr_text = ocr_result.stdout.strip()
    print("\\n--- OCR Result (First Page) ---")
    print(ocr_text if ocr_text else "(no text detected by OCR)")

doc.close()
'''
await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
print("Script written.")

result = await run_command("python ./extract_pdf.py")
print(result)

install_tess = await run_command("apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq tesseract-ocr 2>&1 | tail -5")
